nom: SkinMedica Even & Correct Brightening Treatment Pads For Face Exfoliating

concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report mild, transient skin reactions — one describes the pads as irritating to the touch, another notes a slight tingling in the first few uses that fades quickly.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who address pigmentation report the pads faded brown spots, melasma, or a dark acne mark, in some cases after products like peels hadn't helped; one reviewer, however, reports zero difference in her brown spots despite diligent use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge: one reviewer credits the pads with keeping her skin clear, while another reports breaking out while using them.

aspects.libelle: Packaging from third-party sellers can leak in shipping

extraits.titre: Did not even lighten my brown spots
extraits.texte: I use these diligently and there was Zero difference in the brown spots on my skin. My brown spots are not incredibly dark. I don't know who this stuff worked for but definitely did not for me. Better off spending your money on a peel or laser lift.
It feels irritating on the skin and I don’t like the scent. I won’t buy it again. Save your money.

I’ve been using these for about two years and swear by them! I have found they’ve helped with my melasma and helps keep my skin clear. I use them at bedtime after I wash my face before using my red light mask and putting on a night serum. When you first start using them you may feel a little tingle the first few times you use them, but it’s minor and goes away.

I purchased this product a couple weeks ago and it is WORKING! I've had a very dark acne spot for a couple years I've been trying to lighten and this has already helped tremendously in the short time I've used it! Will be order some other items from this line!
Not a fan of this product. I feel like the medicine.. I broke out while using this product.
I recently switched to these instead of my usual pads and there’s no Going Back I really see a difference in my pores And my skins seems brighter !
I have had great success with these pads evening my skin tone and removing brown spots that other products would not help.

reserve: No reviewer in this set states her skin type, so no skin-type segments could be drawn; conclusions rest on a small sample of nine reviews.
